differences.justification: MongoClient is intentionally exposed by MongoDbEmbeddingStore as the connection entry point to a MongoDB deployment; this is the natural public configuration surface for the integration.
CreateCollectionOptions is intentionally exposed by MongoDbEmbeddingStore builder/configuration APIs for custom collection setup.
Bson is intentionally exposed by MongoDbEmbeddingStore's filter configuration API, allowing callers to pass driver-native MongoDB filters without introducing a second abstraction layer.
